Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X RS Group purchased and cancelled 175,353 ordinary shares during the week 26–30 October 2026 under its £100.0m share repurchase programme, transacting at a weekly price range of 774.5p–795.0p and daily volume-weighted average prices of 780.8582p, 790.5602p, 789.0864p, 791.1921p and 787.0764p. Since the programme commenced the company has cancelled 6,084,240 shares, leaving 467,965,228 ordinary shares in issue and total voting rights of 467,965,228, with no shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 02 November 2026 RS Group plc 2 November 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 26 October 2026 to 30 October 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
